body.purpose: Unified typography for the single-page portfolio and its dialogs.

narrative.overview: This shipped replica follows the gresfilip competitor canon frozen on 2026-08-27. Snapshot seed snapshot-gresfilip-20260827 is the reference for visual fidelity; preserve the existing composition instead of extending it into a new identity.
keyCharacteristics: One restrained portfolio page with three native dialogs.
Compact editorial presentation centered on the work.

rules.name: The Canon Rule
rules.body: Preserve the frozen reference palette; do not introduce speculative accent colors.

dos: Do treat snapshot-gresfilip-20260827 as the visual canon.
Do keep data in lib/portfolio-data.ts and assets in public/portfolio.
Do verify the 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile targets.
donts: Don't widen the 576px desktop content column.
Don't add pages, custom modal systems, remote assets, or a new visual identity.
Don't reinterpret the competitor canon after its 2026-08-27 freeze.
